description: This file defines the VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync class, which manages synchronization of voice wake triggers with a gateway, including starting/stopping tasks, handling push events, and updating application state.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: Manages synchronization of voice wake settings with the gateway and handles push events related to voice wake.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the sync process, establishing tasks and handling incoming stream of push notifications.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and updates app state.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Processes incoming push events, decoding relevant payloads and updating app state accordingly.
